page_title: PSG 2-1 NAN | PSG v Nantes 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes a short corner kick.
90+5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Good work from PSG as they win a corner.

90+3' Florent Mollet (Nantes) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Arnau Tenas, who pulls off a comfortable save!

90+3' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
90+1' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is booked.
90+1' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Alban Lafont is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
86' Substitution. Kader Bamba (Nantes) replaces Jean-Kevin Duverne.
86' Jocelyn Gourvennec has decided to make a change. Matthis Abline (Nantes) replaces Moussa Sissoko.

85' Marco Asensio (PSG) gets on the end of a pass from Randal Kolo Muani inside the box and quickly shoots, but the effort goes inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
83' 2 - 1 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.

83' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header low into the middle of the target, but Alban Lafont keeps the ball out.
82' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
81' Alban Lafont comes off his line to intercept the corner from Kang-In Lee (PSG).

81' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Bradley Barcola is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marco Asensio (PSG) is coming onto the pitch as Carlos Soler cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
77' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. PSG win a corner.
76' Moses Simon (Nantes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arnau Tenas intercepts the ball.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:7.
73' Jocelyn Gourvennec has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Quentin Merlin (Nantes) replacing Mostafa Mohamed.
72' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alban Lafont, who smothers the ball.
70' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
69' The game is interrupted now, Kylian Mbappe (PSG) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' PENALTY APPEAL after Kylian Mbappe (PSG) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha leaves the pitch and Ousmane Dembele (PSG) comes on.
67' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.

64' Marquinhos (Nantes) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marquinhos (Nantes) will replace Samuel Moutoussamy.
61' Marcus Coco will be replaced by Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes).
61' Substitution. Milan Skriniar (PSG) has come on for Marquinhos.
60' Here is a change. Manuel Ugarte is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
59' Bradley Barcola (PSG) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
57' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Arnau Tenas easily deals with the threat.
55' 1 - 1 Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 1:1.
55' Florent Mollet (Nantes) will take a corner kick.
55' Marcus Coco (Nantes) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player. The referee points to the corner flag and Nantes will take a corner.
54' Wow, what an escape. Kang-In Lee (PSG) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
52' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
52' Kang-In Lee (PSG) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' PSG keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
47' Bradley Barcola (PSG) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' PSG take a short corner kick.

44' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
43' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Arnau Tenas comes off his line to intercept.

41' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Bradley Barcola (PSG). Vitinha plays a fantastic through ball and finds Bradley Barcola (PSG), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the right side of the goal. It's now 1:0.
39' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) picks up a long through ball, but Alban Lafont deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
38' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
35' 72:28 – the ratio of ball possession.
31' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.

31' A rebound sits up nicely for Vitinha (PSG) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.

31' Kang-In Lee (PSG) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
30' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Douglas Augusto (Nantes) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Marcus Coco (Nantes) sends a cross into the box, but Arnau Tenas comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' Kang-In Lee (PSG) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
24' Kang-In Lee (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
24' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. PSG have a corner.
23' A poor mid-range free-kick by Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
22' Marcus Coco (Nantes) jumps into a tackle and Jerome Brisard signals a foul. It's a free kick to PSG in a dangerous position.

21' Kang-In Lee (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
18' Bradley Barcola (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
16' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

15' Florent Mollet (Nantes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out of play and Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Florent Mollet (Nantes) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

15' Florent Mollet (Nantes) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Arnau Tenas sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.
15' Moses Simon (Nantes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' The PSG players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
9' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
5' An attempted cross from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared.
1' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Alban Lafont.
